Position: Tivoli Consultant
 City: Secaucus, New Jersey
 Duration: 3 Months + 
 Description: 
 We have an open Tivoli Consultant position for our direct client in Secaucus NJ for a 3 month contract plus possible extensions. The ideal candidate will be local and have the following expertise:
 Knowledge of the Tivoli set of commands (package compiling deploying etc.)
 Knowledge of the PHP programming language (used to extend Tivoli from a management dashboard perspective)
 Knowledge of Unix commands (Cygwin used to implement Unix like functionality at endpoints)
 Knowledge of the PERL programming language (used to create/implement packages)
 Please submit your most recent word resume along with best all inclusive contract rate.
